feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking a UI update requirement to affected frontend file and component versions.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing functionality of multiple frontend components and pages.
frontend/.gitignore: Git ignore rules for dependencies, build outputs, environment files, IDE settings, OS files, logs, and temp files.
frontend/deploy-logs/.gitkeep: Placeholder file ensuring deploy-logs directory is committed.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/scripts/deploy.ts: Deployment script orchestrating build and deploy steps with retry logic and failure log generation.
frontend/scripts/deploySteps.ts: Utility for running deployment steps with child processes, capturing output, and detecting transient failures.
frontend/scripts/README.md: Documentation for deployment scripts describing reliable rerunnable workflow.
frontend/scripts/redaction.ts: Redaction utilities removing sensitive data such as keys, tokens, PEM blocks, principals, emails, and credentialed URLs from logs.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app managing authentication, routing via hash, language context, profile setup flow, and conditional page rendering.
frontend/src/components/BlogPostModal.ts: Modal for creating or editing blog posts, including image upload, form handling, and timezone conversions.
frontend/src/components/BlogSection.tsx: Displays blog posts and Instagram feed with tabs, video autoplay logic, and admin controls.
frontend/src/components/BlogViewModal.ts: Modal for viewing a blog post with rendered content, metadata, cover image, and view count.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact form with submission handling and static contact info display.
frontend/src/components/CustomStoryImage: Empty placeholder file with no implementation.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer with navigation links, social media icons, and localized text content.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Responsive header with logo, navigation, language selection, login, and admin/tool links, including periodic logo refresh.
frontend/src/components/HeroImageUploade: Admin-only hero image upload component with validation, preview, status handling, and automatic refresh.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero section displaying dynamic hero image and travel tools, with periodic refresh and admin upload interface.
frontend/src/components/InstagramFeedMan: Admin manager for Instagram-like feed items supporting create, edit, delete, media upload, previews, and validation.
frontend/src/components/LanguageSelector: Dropdown language selector allowing users to switch site languages with click-outside handling.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button handling Internet Identity login/logout and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/LogoUploader.tsx: Admin logo upload/update component with validation, status UI, and automatic preview refresh.
frontend/src/components/PackingListManag: React admin tool for managing packing categories, items, and subcategories with editing, ordering, defaults, and resetting to predefined data.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal for creating a user profile with validation, language selection, and saving via API.
frontend/src/components/QuizManager.tsx: Editor for geography and travel‑style quizzes, including questions, options, archetypes, and mock default data.
frontend/src/components/ShopProductManag: Admin interface to create, edit, and delete shop products with image upload, validation, and listing.
frontend/src/components/ShopProductModal: Modal for adding or editing a shop product with image uploads, validation, and submit handling.
frontend/src/components/ShopSection.tsx: Displays the shop section, fetching products, handling product selection, image navigation, and admin product creation modal.
frontend/src/components/ToastContainer.t: Renders and manages toast notifications with icons, styles, and dismiss actions.
Shows a responsive grid of travel tools linking to various site features with icons and descriptions.
frontend/src/components/TravelToolsSecti: Empty or placeholder file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/UserManagement.t: Provides an admin interface to view users, change roles with confirmation, copy data, and display user metadata.
frontend/src/contexts/LanguageContext.ts: Implements a language context with persistence and translation lookup for multiple languages.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the current identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides authentication state and actions using Internet Identity, including login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for admin checks, user profiles, and user management using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global styles, Tailwind imports, custom colors, typography, utilities, animations, and UI effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with Internet Identity and React Query providers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Implements a multi-tab admin dashboard for managing blog posts, users, settings, media, and tools.
frontend/src/pages/BlogDetailPage.tsx: Displays a single blog post with metadata, view count tracking, share support, and styled markdown rendering.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPage.tsx: Shows a paginated list of published blog posts with view counts, localization, and navigation controls.
frontend/src/pages/GeographyQuiz.tsx: Interactive geography quiz component with country data, question generation, scoring, and Instagram story export.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders the homepage layout combining hero, blog, shop, and contact sections.
frontend/src/pages/PackingList.tsx: Packing list manager with default categories, item selection, filtering, and custom item support.
frontend/src/pages/ShopPage.tsx: Displays shop products with search, sorting, product detail modal, and affiliate link handling.
frontend/src/pages/TrainVsFlightPrices.t: Compares mock flight and train options, calculating savings and time differences for users.
frontend/src/pages/TravelStyleQuiz.tsx: Travel personality quiz assigning archetypes based on answers and supporting Instagram story export.
frontend/src/pages/TripRandomizer.tsx: React page that generates random trip packages using mock flights, hotels, images, and destination highlights.
frontend/src/utils/instagramStoryGenerat: Creates Instagram Story images using canvas, supporting gradients, custom backgrounds, logos, and branded styling.
frontend/src/utils/toast.ts: Implements a toast manager for showing, removing, and subscribing to toast notifications.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending colors, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata including features, issues, and pending requests for renaming a shop tile and blog view count initialization.
